item.title: Identity is the ceiling
item.description:
You act like the person you think you are — right up to the edge of it, and no further.

Robbins calls identity the key to expansion, and the warning underneath is sharp: your self-image is a ceiling. You'll spend exactly as much of your talent as your sense of who you are permits. Raise the result above the identity and you snap back, every time, like a thermostat correcting the room.
